titulo: How to Learn a Language Step by Step: Sofia Balderson's 8-Step Route
caption: YouTube only (a regular 16:9 video). Instagram goes as its own piece (-ig) with its own caption.
descripcion:
How to learn a language step by step, the way Sofia Balderson does it. She speaks seven languages, to varying degrees, and wrote down the eight steps she uses every time. Her post: https://notingthemargin.substack.com/p/how-i-learn-languages

We fly her route over a contour map, one waypoint for each step. It starts with an honest goal and input you mostly understand, a little every day, and ends with speaking a lot. At step 5 she says many people quit, and that is where the flight goes fastest.

4:33 What she does not recommend

5:04 Her caveat and the credit

Credits
Post: Sofia Balderson, "How I Learn Languages", Sofia's Notes from the Margin, 11 Jan 2026. https://notingthemargin.substack.com/p/how-i-learn-languages
The method and the figures are hers. She calls her post "a strong starting point".
The retelling is ours (NAOS). Sofia Balderson did not make or endorse this video.
Every NAOS strategy and its sources: https://hardlypythonnmr.github.io/naos-site/biblioteca/

alt: A contour map on a dark field, flown through fast. Lines of code turn into contour lines and tilt into 3D; the camera dives down canyons whose walls close in, toward eight numbered waypoints on a vermilion route, each step's number and heading landing on a beat. At step 5 the music drops out, then six hard cuts down the narrowest canyon with an hours counter running. Calmer flights for steps 6 to 8, six struck-out headings, a held silence over the summit with the words B1 to B2, and the camera pulling back to the whole map. End card: What would you learn a language for? and the credit.
